description: Comprehensive web search, URL content extraction, and research capabilities via You.com's authenticated MCP server. Provides you-search, you-contents, and you-research tools for current web intelligence and cited synthesis.

parsed_description.main: Search the web using You.com's search engine with current results, snippets, and source URLs.
parsed_description.args: query: The search query string. count: Optional number of results to return (default 10, max 20). domain: Optional domain to restrict search to. safesearch: Optional safe search level ('strict', 'moderate', 'off'). country: Optional country code for localized results. freshness: Optional time filter ('day', 'week', 'month', 'year'). livecrawl: Optional crawling mode for real-time results.
parsed_description.returns: SearchResponse object containing web results with titles, URLs, snippets, and metadata
parsed_description.raises: You.com API errors for invalid queries, quota exceeded, or service issues

domain.description: Optional domain to restrict search to (e.g., 'github.com')
domain.title: Domain

parsed_description.main: Extract and read content from specific URLs using You.com's content extraction service.
parsed_description.args: urls: List of URLs to extract content from. timeout: Optional timeout in seconds for extraction.
parsed_description.returns: ContentsResponse object containing extracted text, metadata, and processing status for each URL
parsed_description.raises: You.com API errors for invalid URLs, extraction failures, or service issues

urls.description: List of URLs to extract content from
urls.title: URLs

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for content extraction
timeout.title: Timeout

parsed_description.main: Perform comprehensive research on a topic with cited sources and synthesis using You.com's research engine.
parsed_description.args: query: The research query or topic. depth: Optional research depth ('basic', 'comprehensive'). sources: Optional preferred source types.
parsed_description.returns: ResearchResponse object containing synthesized research with citations, source analysis, and structured findings
parsed_description.raises: You.com API errors for invalid queries, quota exceeded, or service issues

depth.description: Research depth: 'basic' for quick overview or 'comprehensive' for detailed analysis
depth.title: Depth
